children.title: My children
children.emptyBody: Add your children's ages to more easily find parks that suit them.
children.formIntro: So we can suggest parks suited to their age.
children.privacyHint: Toboggo doesn't ask for their exact date of birth.

geoloc.a: Toboggo uses your location to show the nearest parks, sorted by distance. You can also search for a city manually.

filters.q: What do the filters (toilets, shade, age range) mean?
filters.a: This information comes from the community or partner local authorities, and is checked before publication.

addPark.q: How do I add a park?
addPark.a: From the Add tab, enter the name, address and available equipment. Your submission is checked by our team before it appears on the map.

report.q: How do I report a problem?
report.a: Use the “Report a problem” button on the park page. Our team or the relevant local authority updates the information.

municipality.q: I'm a local authority — how do I manage my parks?
municipality.a: Partner local authorities get a dedicated back office. Contact us to enable it.

contact.title: Contact
contact.sentBody: Our team will get back to you shortly.
contact.intro: For a damaged park or incorrect information, please use the “Report” button on the park page instead.

favorites.title: Favorites
favorites.headerSubtitle: Your favorite spots, always at hand.
favorites.emptyDesc: Tap the heart on a park to add it here.

filters.nearbyLocationDesc: Allow location access to see your favorites within {{distance}}.

discover.title: Looking for new parks?
discover.desc: Explore the map and add your favorite spots.

contributions.title: Contributions
contributions.emptyParks: You haven’t added a park yet.
contributions.emptyReviews: You haven’t left a review yet.
contributions.emptyReports: You haven’t reported a problem yet.

privacyScreen.title: Privacy & terms
privacyScreen.deleteConfirmBody: This action is permanent. Your account, your personal data and your reviews will be deleted. Some contributions that help the community (parks added, photos, reports, suggested edits) may be kept anonymously.
privacyScreen.deleteError: We couldn’t delete your account. Please try again in a moment.

accountScreen.signOutHint: You can sign back in at any time.
accountScreen.deleteHint: Permanently deletes your account and personal data.
accountScreen.deleteConfirmDetail: This action is permanent. Your profile, reviews, children you added, favorites and notifications will be deleted. Parks, photos, reports and edits you suggested may be kept anonymously.

about.title: About Toboggo
about.tagline:
Thousands of parks rated
by parents like you.

group.title: Group outing
group.intro: Create an outing to share your live location with other parents at this park, or join one with a code.

appFeedback.title: Rate Toboggo
appFeedback.intro: Your feedback helps us improve Toboggo. It stays private: only the Toboggo team can read it.
appFeedback.introEdit: You already shared your feedback. You can edit it below.
appFeedback.bodyPlaceholder: What do you like? What could we improve?
appFeedback.error: We couldn’t save your feedback. Please try again in a moment.
appFeedback.loadError: We couldn’t load your previous feedback.
appFeedback.sentBody: It has been saved. You can edit it at any time from your profile.
appFeedback.signInPrompt: Sign in to give your feedback on Toboggo.

username.title: Choose your username
username.subtitle: This is the name others will see on Toboggo.
username.label: Your username
username.help: Shown on your reviews and contributions.
username.footnote: You can change it anytime from your profile.
username.tooShort: Your username must be at least {{min}} characters.
